meta.name: bioservices
meta.description: Unified Python interface to 40+ bioinformatics services. Use when querying multiple databases (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, Reactome) in a single workflow with consistent API. Best for cross-database analysis, ID mapping across services. For quick single-database lookups use gget; for sequence/file manipulation use biopython.

copy.tagline: 用统一接口查询40多个生物信息学数据库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个生物数据库间进行联合查询和ID映射
copy.tagline_en: Query 40+ bioinformatics databases with a unified interface
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to query multiple biological databases and map IDs across them

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以帮你用 Python 代码查询 40 多个生物信息学数据库（如 UniProt、KEGG、ChEMBL），获取蛋白质序列、代谢通路、化合物信息，并在不同数据库之间转换标识符。
howto.when: 当你需要同时查询多个生物数据库，或者进行跨数据库的标识符映射、序列比对时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下人类 ZAP70 蛋白的序列和参与的 KEGG 通路。
把 KEGG 化合物 C11222 映射到 ChEMBL 的 ID。
say.note: 会使用 UniChem 服务进行跨数据库标识符转换。

say.text: 用 BLAST 搜索这段蛋白质序列的相似序列。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use Python code to query 40+ bioinformatics databases (e.g., UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL), retrieve protein sequences, pathways, compound info, and map identifiers across databases.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to query multiple biological databases simultaneously, or perform cross-database ID mapping, sequence alignment.

say_en.text: Get the sequence and KEGG pathways for human ZAP70 protein.
say_en.note: Calls UniProt and KEGG services, returns sequence and pathway info.

say_en.text: Map KEGG compound C11222 to its ChEMBL ID.
say_en.note: Uses UniChem service for cross-database identifier conversion.

say_en.text: Run BLAST search for this protein sequence.
say_en.note: Requires NCBI_EMAIL env var; returns BLAST alignment results.
